physical_coverage_audit.diagnostic:
Offline counterexamples: scan-time target circle vs recorded model envelope.

Needs independently labelled observer replay files. A positive boundary excess
is a sampled counterexample; passing samples alone does not prove containment.
No truth or radius is supplied to a controller by this utility.

necessary_condition_audit.interpretation:
Offline check of necessary centre-disk conditions, not an online labeler.

Radial matching (80% within .04m) can include mixed clusters; a violation is
failure of the disk condition, not proof of a particular noise source.

offline_counterfactuals.ray_count_provenance: Explicit 360 from preserved sensor configuration; not claimed recorded in old frames
